summary: - **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#127](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/127)** — Fixes outside-in CKF tracking (`PropagateBackward`): the CKF now starts at the outermost seed space point instead of the innermost, so outer seed hits are kept in the final track. Seed parameters, including the magnetic field, are now estimated at the start space point, which also changes the default inside-out seeding. With `PropagateBackward`, tracks are reversed after smoothing into inside-out order, the CKF stops at the reference surface, and seed states are labelled `AtLastHit`.

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#413](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/413)** — `OverlayTiming` gains a `RandomMixBackgroundFiles` option for beam-induced background produced as many single-event files. Each file in a group is treated as an independent source and drawn from a shuffled permutation that is reshuffled once exhausted, so short runs no longer see only the first few files. Documentation and tests are included; TBB-based parallel reading follows in a separate PR.

- **[PandoraPFAOrg/LCContent#33](https://github.com/PandoraPFAOrg/LCContent/pull/33)** — Adds Pandora particle-flow algorithms for the IDEA option 2 detector. HCAL clustering is seeded by ECAL clusters from k4RecCalorimeter, and the PR adds a dual-readout correction plugin, IDEA PFO creation, and two optional ONNX-based algorithms (photon ID and satellite-cluster merging) built only with `LCContent_BUILD_ML=ON`. It requires PandoraSDK ≥ 04.00.01.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#669](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/669)** — Adds the first version of the ALFA detector concept for FCC-ee (`ALFA_o1_v00`). It includes a Grainita ECAL barrel driver (`Grainita_ECAL_Barrel_v02`) with a dedicated SD action, an outer tracker barrel, a new rho-phi-theta grid segmentation, an example steering file and tests.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#674](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/674)** — `ALLEGRO_o1_v04` now includes its dimensions and other shared compact files directly from `ALLEGRO_o1_v03`, keeping only the HCAL files version-specific. This aligns properties such as the silicon wrapper between the two versions and prevents silent drift between duplicated files.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1706](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1706)** — Fixes volume divisions, which did not assign volume and placement extensions when a volume was divided or a divided volume was placed. The missing extensions caused null-pointer exceptions when traversing the geometry hierarchy.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config#402](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/402)** — ALLEGRO digi/reco steering gains a `siDigitizer` option to use the new `VTXdigitizerDetailed` silicon digitiser instead of `DDPlanarDigi`. Pixel pitches are now read directly from the compact files. Thresholds and smearing for the new digitiser still need to be tuned.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config#407](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/407)** — IDEA_o1_v03 reconstruction takes the GGTF tracking model path from a new `--trackingModel` argument. The ~65 MB model is downloaded only if missing, via an atomic temporary file, so `k4run` no longer needs network access on every invocation; existing workflows are unchanged.

- **[HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter#291](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/291)** — `TopoCaloNoisyCells` stores noise data in a vector via the indexing service instead of a hash map, which is faster and uses less memory. The data is shared through `CaloCellConstantsSvc` to avoid duplication when the tool is configured multiple times; ALLEGRO reconstruction output is verified to be unchanged.

- **[key4hep/k4Bench#245](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Bench/pull/245)** — k4run benchmarks gain an untimed memory pass (`--memory-events`) that attributes every heap allocation to its owning component and records per-event heap snapshots. This lets the nightly benchmarks track per-algorithm memory across the FCC reconstruction chains.

- **[key4hep/k4Bench#250](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Bench/pull/250)** — Benchmarks now record each output file's compressed size per event, broken down by collection. A new Event Size section on both simulation and reconstruction dashboard pages shows current-run breakdowns and nightly history.

- **[HEP-FCC/fcc-physics-events#30](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-physics-events/pull/30)** — Datasets created in DaMI via the single-record form must now carry a DRS request reference (`DRS-<n>`), validated server-side. Creating new navigation values (accelerator, campaign, etc.) is restricted to admins.
